content.text: Crystal Palace has set its sights on Italian defender Davide Calabria, 28, who caught attention during his loan spell at Bologna last season. Now a free agent after his contract with AC Milan ended, Calabria is an attractive option for the club.
The Saudi Pro League side are also interested in Crystal Palace's French forward Jean-Philippe Mateta, 28.
